profile.name: Ivan Bogomolov
profile.title: Frontend Engineer · React Native / React
profile.location: Da Nang, Vietnam · open to remote, hybrid and relocation
profile.summary: Frontend engineer with 5+ years of shipping mobile and web products on React Native, React and TypeScript. I maintain insurance apps with 50k+ users released to 4 app stores, took them 13 React Native versions forward to 0.77 and the New Architecture, and built native payment modules. On my current contract I built two IoT apps from an empty repository to ~70 screens in 6 months.

experience.summary: Two mobile apps for connected devices, built from scratch as the main developer: a companion app for smart cameras and a Bluetooth tracker app for sports gear.
highlights: Took both apps from an empty repository to ~70 screens in 6 months (250+ commits) on bare React Native 0.84+ with the New Architecture and TypeScript.
Designed a Feature-Sliced architecture and a Tamagui UI kit (~40 components, built from Figma mockups); the second app was built on the same foundation.
Device onboarding over Bluetooth LE and Wi-Fi: defined the BLE message format with the firmware team and wrote the integration guide for them.
Live video and real-time device events over Server-Sent Events; push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging.
Background tracking of BLE tags with geolocation, maps and left-behind alerts.
Sign in with Apple / Google and one-time-code login; state in Zustand + MMKV; AI-assisted workflow with Claude Code.

experience.summary: Insurance group. Two mobile apps — for policyholders and for insurance agents, 50k+ users — plus an internal CRM.
highlights: Moved both apps 13 React Native versions forward, from 0.64 to 0.77, and switched them to the New Architecture (Fabric, TurboModules) — unblocking current libraries and OS versions.
Launched SBP (Faster Payments System) payments through a custom native module for Android and iOS — a new in-app payment channel.
Built an in-app update flow without third-party libraries, so users move to new versions without leaving the app.
Shipped real-time chat over WebSocket, push notifications and biometric login (Face ID / Touch ID).
Released to 4 stores — App Store, Google Play, AppGallery and RuStore; tracked and fixed production crashes with Sentry.
Rewrote legacy modules on Redux Toolkit + RTK Query + TypeScript with Feature-Sliced Design.
React: internal CRM, product metrics and user analytics used to validate product hypotheses.

experience.summary: Enterprise product for the bank's internal users.
highlights: Developed features on a React + Redux Toolkit + TypeScript architecture.
Integrated the GraphQL API through Apollo Client.
Optimized rendering performance and fixed cross-browser issues.

experience.summary: Language learning service with millions of users.
highlights: Rebuilt the main page — the entry point of the website — pixel-perfect to the new design.
Created the UI kit of the new design system as a standalone npm package (Ant Design + TypeScript).
Helped design the new app architecture (Next.js + MobX), did cross code review and supported the in-site learning games.

experience.summary: Outsourcing and outstaffing: worked on 8 client projects in a year — 3 React Native apps and 5 web apps.
highlights: Built a Mafia-style multiplayer game end to end: architecture, drag-and-drop animations, MVP on REST, then moved to WebSockets for real-time play.
Analytics app (React Native): SVG charts (pie, bar, line, Gantt) and maps (Mapbox, OpenStreetMap); made it faster with memoization and a move from class components to hooks.
Introduced Redux into an education platform and refactored it; added TypeScript typing to a document management system.
Also: hotel guest app (React Native), API testing tool similar to Postman, hotel CRM and an aircraft insurance website.

items: New Architecture: Fabric, TurboModules, JSI, Codegen
